Jeļena " Aļona " Ostapenko [ 2 ] (born 8 June 1997) is a Latvian professional tennis player. She has been ranked by the Women's Tennis Association (WTA) as high as world No. 5 in singles, which she achieved on 19 March 2018, and No. 3 in doubles, attained on 14 July 2025. [ 3 ] She is the current No. 1 singles player from Latvia, on both categories. Ostapenko has won nine WTA Tour -level singles and twelve doubles titles, including a singles major at the 2017 French Open and a doubles major at the 2024 US Open , partnering Lyudmyla Kichenok .
